components.css: .ds-cap{border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3);padding:20px;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%,rgba(34,211,238,0.14),rgba(11,19,37,0.9) 60%);font-family:Inter,sans-serif;color:#e2e8f0;transition:background-color 500ms,border-color 500ms}.ds-cap:hover{border-color:rgba(52,211,153,0.6);background:rgba(2,44,34,0.4);animation:ds-bloom 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both}@keyframes ds-bloom{from{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153,0.55),0 12px 32px -8px rgba(52,211,153,0)}to{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(52,211,153,0),0 12px 32px -8px rgba(52,211,153,0.35)}}.ds-cap-qty{margin:0;font:400 1.125rem/1 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#a5f3fc}.ds-cap-name{margin:6px 0 0;font:700 1.5rem/1.25 Orbitron,sans-serif;color:#fff}.ds-cap-meta{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:.75rem;color:#94a3b8}.ds-cap-dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 16px;margin:20px 0 0;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(51,65,85,0.6)}.ds-cap-dl dt{font-size:.75rem;color:#94a3b8}.ds-cap-dl dd{margin:4px 0 0;font:400 1rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff}

components.css: .ds-round{position:relative;padding:24px 0 0 36px;font-family:Inter,sans-serif;color:#cbd5e1}.ds-spine{position:absolute;left:15px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:rgba(52,211,153,0.7)}.ds-node{position:absolute;left:9px;top:1.85rem;width:13px;height:13px;transform:rotate(45deg);border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #34d399;background:#020617;box-shadow:0 2px 10px -2px rgba(52,211,153,0.6)}.ds-round-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px}.ds-round-head h4{margin:0;font:700 .875rem Orbitron,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.025em;color:#fff}.ds-pill{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:9999px;background:rgba(52,211,153,0.15);color:#a7f3d0;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500}.ds-band{list-style:none;margin:8px -12px 0;padding:0 12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(52,211,153,0.06);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(52,211,153,0.25)}.ds-step{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0}.ds-tick{position:relative;flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-tick input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-tick span{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,0.7);background:rgba(52,211,153,0.1);color:#6ee7b7;box-shadow:0 4px 14px -4px rgba(52,211,153,0.45);transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms}.ds-tick input:checked+span{background:#34d399;border-color:#6ee7b7;color:#022c22;box-shadow:none}.ds-tick input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid #67e8f9;outline-offset:2px}.ds-step-name{margin:0;font-size:.9375rem;color:#fff}.ds-step-name b{font:400 .875rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace;color:#a5f3fc;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-recipe{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.625}.ds-recipe b{font-weight:400;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-recipe b.r{color:#6ee7b7}.ds-recipe i{font-style:normal;color:#64748b}

narrative.overview:
ATLAS is a starship's instrument panel brought to a phone propped beside the PC. A near-black void ground, washed with faint cyan and purple nebula light, carries translucent glass panels with a hairline cyan edge. Display type is Orbitron, used sparingly for screen titles, card titles, round labels and the planner's product; everything else is quiet Inter, and every quantity is JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, so numbers read like instrument readouts and line up column to column.

Density is moderate and glance-first: one answer per card, detail on demand, touch targets of at least 40px (44px for anything ticked mid-session). Colour is semantic rather than decorative. Cyan means an amount or the scanner's focus, emerald means done or ready, amber means Units (money), purple belongs to exotic and register content, crimson to the planet mark and outlaw status. The accent hues appear as tinted fills at 10-15% alpha with a 30-60% alpha border, almost never as solid blocks; the one solid fill is the emerald of a completed tick or the primary action.

The world's material is light on glass: depth comes from translucency, backdrop blur and soft coloured glow (a ready tick, a lit round node, the exotic slot, the capstone's bloom), never from hard or offset shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Void ground (near-black blue) with three faint radial nebula washes, fixed to the page.
Glass HUD cards: 85% opaque panel, 12px backdrop blur, hairline sky-blue edge, 16px corners.
Orbitron for titles only; Inter for reading; JetBrains Mono tabular figures for every number.
Semantic accents as tinted fills plus a stronger tinted border.
Phosphor icons (bold weight by default) as the only icon set.
Light-based depth: glow and blur, no offset shadows.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each accent hue carries one meaning: cyan is amount or focus, emerald is done or ready, amber is Units or caution. A new screen reuses the meaning, never the hue for decoration.

rules.name: The Tint-and-Edge Rule
rules.body: Accent states are a 10-15% alpha fill with a 30-70% alpha border of the same hue (an on segment, a ready band, a pill, the jump button). Solid accent fills are reserved for a completed tick and the primary action.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Every number a player compares is JetBrains Mono with `tabular-nums`. Inter never sets a quantity.

rules.name: The Short Burst Rule
rules.body: Orbitron is for names and titles of a few words; it never sets a sentence.

rules.name: The Glow Means State Rule
rules.body: A coloured glow is never decoration: it marks something ready, lit, exotic or complete. Resting controls carry no glow.

dos: **Do** set every quantity and value in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, in quantity-cyan for amounts and units-amber-pale for Units.
**Do** build containers as HUD cards: hud-panel-glass, 12px blur, 1px hud-edge, 16px corners, card-lift shadow.
**Do** express states as tint-and-edge (10-15% fill, 30-70% border) in the hue that carries the meaning.
**Do** keep tick and tap targets at 44px (40px minimum for steppers and secondary buttons) and inputs at 1rem below 640px.
**Do** pair each card title (Orbitron 700, 1rem) with one bold Phosphor icon in the card's semantic hue.
**Do** honour reduced motion: the shared rule zeroes all transitions; signature moments (the bloom, the spine fill) must settle to their end state.
**Do** use the cyan focus outline (2px, offset 2px) on every focusable element, including visually hidden checkboxes via their drawn target.
donts: **Don't** use an accent hue for decoration or outside its meaning (cyan for a Units value, amber for done).
**Don't** add hard or offset shadows; depth is blur, soft lift and state glow.
**Don't** set sentences or body copy in Orbitron.
**Don't** use text glyphs or emoji as icons; Phosphor is the icon set.
**Don't** put an uppercase mono label above a heading as a kicker; the uppercase label style only names the group it heads.
**Don't** load fonts, icons or styles from a CDN; everything is bundled.
